title: Sharp Second-Order Minimax Risk for Unequal Three-Arm Contrasts

proof_attempt_summary: The run built a response-alphabet/Airy program, repaired a false widening-tube prior with a face-robust construction, and derived a sharp unrestricted second-order theorem for cdagger=(1,-1/4,-3/4), together with general-c results under the fixed independent qstar design. The original promise required the unrestricted limit, evaluator, converse, and qstar design comparison for every permitted fixed K and c; that all-sign-partition bridge was never proved, so substituting the cdagger kill-test theorem for the promised kernel failed the fidelity gate. A future retry should reuse the proved artifacts but must supply genuinely general 2^K-response-alphabet tube, face, evaluator, and unrestricted-converse mathematics.
tldr: For the unequal three-arm contrast \(c^\dagger=(1,-1/4,-3/4)\), the unrestricted design--estimator game has the proved sharp expansion \(R_n(c^\dagger)=n^{-1}-C_A(5/8)^{2/3}n^{-4/3}+o(n^{-4/3})\). The contrast-weighted independent allocation \(q^\dagger=(1/2,1/8,3/8)\) attains the same second-order coefficient, and the binary eight-type construction supplies a terminating finite-input certificate with a computable all-future error tail. An exact endpoint-reduction theorem also transports both the unrestricted three-arm result and the general fixed-independent benchmark to every fixed bounded interval \([L,U]\), multiplying risk by \((U-L)^2\). The bounded lift is mathematically total, but no exact Turing claim is made for unrepresented real endpoints or observations.
gap: The accepted parent proves the \(n^{-4/3}\) order and exact finite programs but leaves the sharp face-and-corner limit open. Sudijono, Dobriban, and Tchetgen Tchetgen obtain a scalar two-arm Airy expansion, and Hull's unrestricted bounded-outcome theorem is also two-arm. Neither paper supplies a nonzero transverse prior, an unequal three-arm allocation-count expansion, or a cross-sample certificate modulus.
fill: The project gives explicit longitudinal and transverse response measures, the finite factorial likelihood and target identity, residue-indexed finite coefficient arrays on fixed lattice charts with certified Euler--Maclaurin and uniform Stirling remainders, the parent's exact all-design orbit transfer, an exact shell-and-boundary partition, and a terminating exact-algebraic certificate whose single prescribed schedules separately budget tube, shell, action-grid, sequence, and enclosure errors.
